basis: On Rambus’s public Q2 earnings call, CFO Desmond Lynch said, “Under ASC 606, we expect revenue in the third quarter between $96 million and $102 million.” The $102,000,000 high end was 9.13% below Q3 2022 consolidated revenue of $112,244,000 and below the $106,631,800 cutoff. Lynch said the outlook included the PHY IP business. The linked transcript preserves his remarks. Rambus’s own release confirms the call date and directs investors to the call for full revenue guidance.

coverage.detail: May 1, preceding earnings cycle. Rambus gave revenue ranges for Q2 2023. Its release contained no consolidated Q3 revenue range.
On the May 1 call, management discussed the DDR4-to-DDR5 transition and the outlook for product revenue. The call supplied no numeric ceiling for Q3 consolidated revenue.

The May 25 investor-event notice announced June appearances by CEO Luc Seraphin and distinguished inventor Steven Woo. The notice gave no financial outlook. The search of June conference materials found no earlier Q3 consolidated revenue range.
July 20, proposed PHY IP sale. The companies expected an immaterial effect on revenue and earnings for the year. The Q3 reference concerned the expected closing date.

July 31, release before the call. Q3 component highs were $32 million in royalties, $53 million in product revenue and $23 million in contract and other revenue. They sum to $108 million, above the cutoff. Rambus identified licensing billings as a separate operating metric and reserved full revenue guidance for the call.
The Q2 webcast slides repeated the Q3 component ranges, with royalty revenue in a footnote. Lynch supplied the narrower $96 million to $102 million consolidated range orally.
September 7, sale completion announcement. Rambus expressly affirmed its July 31 guidance for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2023.
October 11. Rambus announced the October 30 results call without giving preliminary revenue.

October 30 actuals. The consolidated statement of operations reports total revenue of $105,298,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2023, against $112,244,000 a year earlier. Actual revenue exceeded the July forecast high and still fell 6.19% year over year.

The Q3 Form 10-Q confirms that the PHY IP sale closed September 6 and that its results remained in continuing operations. The October release’s reported prior-year comparative therefore supplies the applicable GAAP base.

publication_date_evidence: Rambus’s issuer-IR release is dated July 31, 2023 and scheduled the public earnings call for 2:00 p.m. Pacific that day. The July 31 call transcript records Lynch delivering the Q3 ASC 606 range during prepared remarks.
